messages.subject: distance sampling mentor in Ghana
parts:
Hi Distance Sampling list,

Does anyone undertake any distance sampling surveys in Ghana, or nearby? I've
been contacted by a Ghanaian, Nicholas Aduse-Gyan (she...@yahoo.com), who is
looking for help in understanding how the methods work, and using the software.
If you think you can help, please contact him directly, at the above email
address. Thanks!

- Len Thomas

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator, Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Environmental and Ecological Modelling
The Observatory, University of St Andrews, Scotland KY16 9LZ

email: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
